criteria.requirement: Workers list/show read canonical worker families and worker-authored adverts through scoped subscriptions by default.
Build get/list and artifact get/list read canonical registry events; missing or malformed IDs fail explicitly.
Table and JSON output match explicit REST fallback for worker, build, and artifact reads.
Reads reuse the persisted cursor; stale local reads warn and exit 0.
Build, artifact, worker-family, and worker-advertisement decoders preserve typed content and honor tombstones.
